citation: Mars M., de Graaf C., Teo P.S., van Langeveld A. (2020). Taste, Fat and Texture Database - taste values Dutch Foods (SVT), v004. DANS, doi:10.17026/dans-xst-ughm. CC-BY-SA-4.0.
panel: 15 trained panellists (12 F / 3 M), modified Spectrum method, 0-100 line scale anchored with sucrose/NaCl/citric acid/caffeine/MSG solutions and reference foods; triplicate ratings averaged (Teo et al. 2018 Food Qual Pref 65:49).
assumptions: Single HFP ingredient per food (100 g) or the 2-ingredient prep stated by SVT. Cooked foods: cook_min at 95 C (affects cooked nucleotides and cysteine sulfoxides only; no water loss or leaching modelled). Fridge-served: 5.5 C (sweetness only). Solid foods: the model computes water-phase concentrations.
